New Huge Commission Comic featuring another virus, heavily inspired by The Hyper Pandemic series! Something has seeped into Willow Creek High's water supply, causing those affected to transform one by one into hyper voluptuous, sex crazed maniacs!

Features hyper expansion, corruption, transformation, mind break, and more~ Hope you like it!

If you liked what you saw and want to support my work, please consider joining my Patreon where you'll get exclusive early access to all my future comics: https://www.patreon.com/VirusB90
